subject: SOC 2 re-attestation + renewal: evidence handoff & retention change request
body:
--- Message 1 of 4 ---
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
From: Oriana Gomez <ogomez@bluewave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, BlueWave Security <security@bluewave.com>
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal evidence requests

Karthik / Laura —

As we approach our contract renewal (June 30), BlueWave’s security and procurement teams need materials for our re-attestation and vendor review. High level ask below — can’t stress timing enough, procurement wants paperwork consolidated by 6/22 to stay on the renewal cadence.

Key items we need:
- Current SOC 2 report and monitoring attestations (if available)
- Raw evidence for controls: access logs, change-management artifacts, incident response runbooks (last 12 months)
- Audit-log retention policy and any existing retention/export examples (we keep 90/365 windows)
- Proof of encryption at rest + KMS key rotation schedule

We also have a small commercial ask: we’re evaluating a 2x capacity bump and a longer term if controls are in order. Procurement asked for a proposed mutual action plan and an example retention spec for audit logs.

Attached: BlueWave_Audit_Request.pdf (outline of our evidence items)

Can Redwood either upload artifacts to our secure SFTP or provide a temporary read-only storage link?

Thanks —
Oriana Gomez
Sr. InfoSec Manager, BlueWave Analytics
ogomez@bluewave.com

--- Message 2 of 4 ---
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Oriana Gomez <ogomez@bluewave.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal evidence requests

Oriana — thanks for the clear list. We can support the re-attestation timeline and likewise discuss committed capacity and term options. Proposed plan below (high-level):

1) Evidence handoff (parallel uploads) — we will stage artifacts into a secure, time-limited S3 bucket (pre-signed links) and provide checksums. Preferred delivery cadence: 6/16 (initial batch), 6/20 (final batch).
2) Evidence set we will provide: SOC2 report (most recent), access audit exports (30/90/365-day slices where available), change-management tickets, incident post-mortems, key-rotation logs. See attachment: SOC2_Evidence_List_v2.xlsx for the mapping to your items.
3) Retention proposal — we’ll provide a retention spec doc for audit logs (Retention_Data_Spec.pdf). Note: our default production log retention is 90 days for high-frequency logs and 365 days for archival traces; we can support custom exports for attestations.
4) Commercial cadence — draft mutual action plan attached (MutualActionPlan_Draft.docx). Suggested commercial path: 24-month term with 2x committed capacity + a 10% uplift discount on committed tokens. We’ll confirm pricing after security review but wanted to put it on the table.

Action items for Redwood (owner in parentheses):
- Upload initial evidence bundle and share links (Vivek)
- Confirm retention examples and spec (Laura)
- Finalize mutual action plan for signature (Karthik)

If procurement needs DocuSign for an amended SOW or capacity addendum, send the contact and timeline and I’ll push to legal.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0198

--- Message 3 of 4 ---
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:30:00 -0700
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.ai>
Subject: Internal: BlueWave evidence plan and retention lift

Team — looping in Rafael for legal touch and to confirm we can support the suggested handoff dates. Summary of internal decisions:

- Evidence owner: Vivek will coordinate the S3 staging and produce checksums for each bundle. He’ll start with exports for the last 12 months and a compressed archive for change tickets. (Vivek)
- Retention/Logs: Our infra team confirms we can generate 30/90/365 slices for access logs; for KV cache tracing we only maintain 30 days by default — request from BlueWave for 365-day archival must be a one-off export or a short-term retention uplift. Proposed response: offer exported archives and a whitepaper on log retention; we’ll not change global retention but we can accommodate attestation exports. (Laura)
- Legal/Procurement: Rafael to review the mutual action plan and the proposed 24-month + 2x capacity commercial term. He flagged the need for a standard SOW amendment and an approved discount matrix. (Rafael)

Open risks:
- Deliverable volume: SOC evidence produces lots of artifacts; we should compress and redact PII where applicable.
- Timeline squeeze: Procurement wants consolidated docs by 6/22. We should prioritize the SOC report + access logs as the first batch.

I’ll draft the technical note on retention and share by EOD 6/16. Vivek, can you confirm expected upload ETA for the initial batch?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Head of Security Programs, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai

--- Message 4 of 4 ---
Date: Thu, 17 Jun 2027 16:48:00 -0700
From: Oriana Gomez <ogomez@bluewave.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@bluewave.com>, BlueWave Security <security@bluewave.com>
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation + renewal evidence requests

Karthik / team — appreciate the quick coordination. BlueWave confirms we accept the proposed approach:

- Please upload the initial evidence bundle by 6/16 (SOC + access logs for the last 90 days). Final bundle by 6/20.
- For retention: the exported archives (30/90/365 slices) are sufficient for our attestation; we don’t require a permanent retention policy change as long as we receive the exports and a retention spec.
- Commercial: Procurement is prepared to move forward with a 24-month term and 2x committed capacity contingent on the security review completing satisfactorily. We’ll sign the mutual action plan once legal confirms redlines.

Next steps from our side:
- I’ll route the mutual action plan to procurement for DocuSign and share timeline (target: sign by 6/24).
- We’ve attached a signed NDA for your records (Signed-NDA.pdf).

Please confirm when the S3 links are live and send checksums.

Thanks —
Oriana
Sr. InfoSec Manager, BlueWave Analytics
ogomez@bluewave.com
